"Empowering the rural youth of Assam through accessible, quality higher education since 1993."
Manikpur Anchalik College, situated at Manikpur in the district of Bongaigaon, Assam, is a premier degree college offering B.A (General & Major) and H.S (Arts) courses. Established in 1993 and conveniently located along NH-31, only two kilometres from Patiladaha Railway Station, the college is affiliated to Gauhati University and recognised by UGC under 2(f) and 12(B).
Over three decades, the institution has remained steadfast in its mission to provide quality higher education to students from rural and semi-urban backgrounds. Steps have been initiated to introduce Science programmes as per Assam Government directives, further expanding the academic horizon for our students.
